# Security Policy

Please do not report vulnerabilities in public issues. Use
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/kitos9112/addon-influxdb/security/advisories/new)
for this repository. Include a reproduction, affected version, and potential
impact. The maintainer will acknowledge and coordinate a fix and disclosure.

For vulnerabilities in InfluxDB itself, also follow
[InfluxData's security policy](https://github.com/influxdata/influxdb/security/policy).
